en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverfront cityscape with several tall church spires and a large domed-tower building on the skyline. In the foreground is a wooden pier with small boats and a side‑wheel river steamer carrying passengers. The opposite bank is lined with substantial masonry buildings and greenery. There is a small, faint text block in the lower right corner but it is not clearly legible.
